Title: Integrate Active Directory with App Service Web Apps

Body.Content: With Azure Websites Authentication / Authorization, you can quickly and easily restrict access to your websites running on Azure Websites by leveraging Azure Active Directory. This feature was previously available only in manage.windowsazure.com, but is now also available in the Azure portal. For more information, see the following blog post: Azure Websites Authentication / Authorization.
Body.Markdown:
With Azure Websites Authentication / Authorization, you can quickly and easily restrict access to your websites running on Azure Websites by leveraging Azure Active Directory. This feature was previously available only in manage.windowsazure.com, but is now also available in the Azure portal .

For more information, see the following blog post: Azure Websites Authentication / Authorization .
